citations.title: Prophet's Prey
citations.snippet: Prophet's Prey is a 2015 American documentary film directed by Amy J. Berg. The film is an adaptation of the 2011 book "Prophet's Prey: My Seven-Year Investigation into Warren Jeffs and the Fundamentalist Church of Latter-Day Saints". It premiered at the 2015 Sundance Film Festival and had its television premiere on October 10, 2015.
